description: Propose an employer-brand / recruiting marketing plan (roles, audience, channels, compliance)

description_i18n.en: Propose an employer-brand / recruiting marketing plan (roles, audience, channels, compliance)
description_i18n.zh_CN: 提出雇主品牌/招聘营销计划（岗位、受众、渠道、合规）
description_i18n.zh_HK: 提出僱主品牌/招聘營銷計劃（崗位、受眾、渠道、合規）

propose_guide: Use when NL asks for a hiring push, employer brand campaign, campus recruit, or open-role promo. Emit Internal structure: roles/levels, candidate persona, EVP/message pillars, channel mix (LinkedIn Company Page, career site CMS, email nurture, optional Meta reach — ads write is out of catalog), calendar, KPIs (applicants, qualified, offer accept), and compliance (EEO, no discriminatory language, accurate compensation claims). Downstream: marketing/brand-voice → ab-copy → linkedin/publish, wordpress/post or webflow/cms-publish, mailchimp/campaign or klaviyo/campaign, hubspot/contact-upsert for CRM leads — all write-external under human gates. Never invent salary bands or legal disclaimers; flag when Owner must supply them.

propose_guide_i18n.en: When NL asks for hiring/employer-brand/campus recruit plan. Emit Internal structure; writes go to gated connectors.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 用户要招聘/雇主品牌/校园招聘计划时使用。产出内部结构；外发走带门控连接器。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 用戶要招聘/僱主品牌/校園招聘計劃時使用。產出內部結構；外發走帶門控連接器。
